title: Gnome World’s Water and Way, in Hazel
blurb: The water and the speed run's way, made cheaper in Gnome world 0.0.150 and written in Hazel too, each Hazel version off by default and the same as the page's JavaScript to the bit. The speed run takes 56.9 s where it took 65.1 s. The water in Hazel takes 13 times the time of the page's, and the way in Hazel 28 times: the same answers, but Hazel has no arrays, so a block of tiles crosses as a list and a search keeps its best costs in a tree. Most of the water's work is seepage of under a thousandth of a tile a step; letting that sleep makes the run 2.2 times as fast, with 24% fewer flooded tiles: Matthew chose it, and 0.0.151 has it.
